format: html

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidymodels)
set.seed(516)
df_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/election2016.csv"
election2016 = read.csv(df_url)
```
:::


Specify model (LASSO; `mixture = 1`):


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lasso_spec=linear_reg(penalty = tune(),mixture=1) |>
  set_engine("glmnet")
```
:::


Set CV plan


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cv_plan=vfold_cv(election2016[,2:10],v=10)
```
:::


Tune hyperparameter $\lambda$ ("penalty"):


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# c(-3,-1) changes the range of penalties considered to
# between 10^(-3) and 10^(-1)
lambda_grid=grid_regular(penalty(c(-3,-1)),levels=50)
lasso_fit=tune_grid(lasso_spec,
                    trump.vote ~ .,
                    cv_plan,
                    grid = lambda_grid)
autoplot(lasso_fit)
```

Finalize Model


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
best_lambda=select_best(lasso_fit,metric="rmse")
final_lasso=finalize_model(lasso_spec,best_lambda)
final_fit_lasso=fit(final_lasso,
                    trump.vote~.,
                    election2016[,2:10])
```
:::
